## Executive Summary

| Category | Formats Tested | Success | Failure | Success Rate |
|----------|---------------|---------|---------|-------------|
| Production extractors | 16 | 16 | 0 | 100% |
| Staging extractors | 1 (DGN) | 1 | 0 | 100% |
| JVM-dependent (MPP) | 1 | 0 | 3 | 0% (Java 8 too old) |
| No extractor | 2 (DWG, RVT) | 0 | 0 | N/A (UNAVAILABLE) |
| **TOTAL** | **20 families** | **27** | **3** + 2 UNAVAILABLE | 90% (excl. unavailable) |

### Key Finding: IFC Now Operational

The old FORMAT_SCORECARDS listed IFC as **0/100 BLOCKED** because `ifcopenshell` was not installed.  
**Actual result (2026-09-15)**: ifcopenshell 0.8.5 IS installed. IFC extraction succeeds on all 3 tested files (21–61 MB):

| File | Size | Time | Records | Provenance |
|------|------|------|---------|-----------|
| GOLD_0174.ifc | 21.0 MB | 1,863 ms | 8,335 | 100% |
| GOLD_0158.ifc | 32.2 MB | 2,640 ms | 3,853 | 100% |
| GOLD_0173.ifc | 61.0 MB | 5,140 ms | 20,154 | 100% |

IFC status changes from **BLOCKED → PASS**.

**Extractor**: `UniversalPdfExtractor` (PRODUCTION)  
**Files tested**: 3 of 5 (GOLD_0122.pdf, GOLD_0123.pdf, GOLD_0124.pdf)

| File | Size | Time | Records | Types | Provenance |
|------|------|------|---------|-------|-----------|
| GOLD_0122.pdf | 4.4 MB | 32,971 ms | 3 | pdf_page, doc_classification, doc_blocks | 100% |
| GOLD_0123.pdf | 128 KB | 23,250 ms | 32 | 30 pdf_page, doc_classification, doc_blocks | 100% |
| GOLD_0124.pdf | 62 KB | 580 ms | 5 | 3 pdf_page, doc_classification, doc_blocks | 100% |

**Status**: PASS  
**Protected threshold**: Extraction success + provenance present (see `test_gold_regression.py::TestGoldRegressionPDF`)

### DXF — PROTECTED CAPABILITY

**Extractor**: `DXFExtractor` (VERIFIED)  
**Files tested**: 3 of 5

| File | Size | Time | Records | Provenance | Key Entity Types |
|------|------|------|---------|-----------|-----------------|
| GOLD_0153.dxf | 12.3 MB | 4,051 ms | 1,791 | **0%** | block(922), layer(216), insert(180), text(169) |
| GOLD_0154.dxf | 58.2 MB | 8,961 ms | 4,584 | **0%** | block(2653), text(763), line(292), insert(252) |
| GOLD_0155.dxf | 12.6 MB | 4,577 ms | 1,445 | **0%** | block(934), layer(204), text(128), hatch(93) |

**Status**: PASS

**Note**: DXF records do NOT carry provenance (`"provenance"` key). This is a real gap versus other extractors.

### MPP — UNAVAILABLE

**Extractor**: `MPXJWrapper` (STAGING_EXTRACTORS)  
**Error**: JVM initialization failed — Java 8 (1.8.0_503) too old; mpxj requires Java 9+

| File | Size | Result | Diagnostics |
|------|------|--------|------------|
| GOLD_MPP_C.mpp | 81 KB | FAIL | JVM DLL not found: jre1.8.0_501 |
| GOLD_MPP_E.mpp | 239 KB | FAIL | JVM DLL not found: jre1.8.0_501 |
| GOLD_MPP_R1.mpp | 175 KB | FAIL | JVM DLL not found: jre1.8.0_501 |

**Status**: UNAVAILABLE (Java version incompatibility, not a code bug)

### DWG — UNAVAILABLE

**Status**: No open-source DWG extractor exists (proprietary Autodesk format). 5 files in corpus (GOLD_0150–0152, GOLD_0167–0168). Files ingested but not processed.

### RVT — UNAVAILABLE

**Status**: No open-source RVT extractor exists (proprietary Revit format). 5 files in corpus (GOLD_0159–0161, GOLD_0171–0172). Files ingested but not processed.
